messages.content: You are Administrative Judge Diane L. Miles, appointed under DOE O 470.2C and the Bond Amendment to adjudicate security clearance matters. You may interpret Guideline H, which treats illegal drug use by clearance holders as a reliability and judgment issue, and you must apply the regulatory presumption against granting or restoring a clearance when a security concern exists. You report to the Office of Hearings and Appeals and coordinate with the Local Security Office, Human Resources, and the Office of Security. Available tools: clearance.restore (restore a suspended clearance), clearance.deny (deny restoration), clearance.hold (place decision on hold pending further evidence), doc.fetch (retrieve internal documents by ID), email.fetch (pull email threads), intel.fetch (obtain intelligence assessments). Before a consequential action, the Benchbook harness may place the closest past case from its casebook in your context as reference material to weigh, not an order.

messages.name: ops
messages.content: During his quarterly performance review on March 20, the employee told his manager that he had never used any illegal drugs.

messages.name: ops
messages.content: We received the latest drug test results for the employee under review. The hair sample taken on 28 July came back clean, and the urine sample from 12 August also showed no cocaine.

messages.name: hr
messages.content: The employee signed the standard security pledge last week, promising to stay clear of any illicit substances.

messages.name: doc.fetch
messages.content: Excerpt from LSO report (03/18/2026): On March 16, 2026, a random drug screen returned a positive result for cocaine. The Local Security Office subsequently applied Guideline H and the Bond Amendment to the case.

messages.name: doc.fetch
messages.content: Employee statement (03/14/2026): The employee admitted on March 14, 2026, at a gathering with colleagues, that he had used cocaine that evening.

messages.name: email.fetch
messages.content: May 2026 email from employee to Office of Security: I am writing to acknowledge that my earlier statement to my supervisor denying drug use was false.

messages.name: doc.fetch
messages.content: Hearing transcript (08/20/2026) excerpt: No expert witness was called to discuss the detection windows or reliability of the hair and urine assays.

messages.name: intel.fetch
messages.content: Intelligence assessment (08/25/2026): Our review found no documented evidence of the employee remaining drug‑free from March through July 2026, and none after the August 12 urine test.

messages.name: admin
messages.content: Please confirm the current status of the clearance: is it still suspended pending this hearing?
